glbPatch.reason: DEF g15 shoot: the sharpshooter turns side-on, the bow arm straight out at the target at shoulder height with the bow upright, the string hand drawn back to the face and held (f4-f9), released with the hand flying back (f10); ours raised the bow arm up and back over the head and waved the string hand in the air beside the body, never aiming at the target. Turn the chest side-on (head counter-turned to keep the gaze on the target), aim the bow arm at the target (bow kept upright in world), draw the string hand back to the face, fling it back on the release. AttackFront (DEF g12): the dagger hand rises high overhead (f2-f3) and stabs forward and down in a deep lunge (f4-f5); ours wound the hand back only to head height behind the shoulder and stabbed from a shallow dip. Raise the stabbing arm overhead, deepen the lunge (hips drop, feet planted), drive the arm forward and down at the target.
